principles: story metadata belongs to the story branch during main sync
real code conflicts must remain explicit
drivers: BUG-4 can still happen during manual git merge main
agents forget ours/theirs direction in story worktrees
DONE gate already depends on story branch containing main

options.name: A: add story_sync_main command
pros: gives agents one safe command to follow
cons: adds another CLI command to document and test

options.name: B: only improve DONE gate hint
cons: still relies on users remembering and correctly applying --ours

options.name: C: auto merge main inside DONE confirm
cons: DONE confirm would perform larger mutations and may surprise users when code conflicts appear

rationale: 选择 A，因为问题核心是手动 merge main 的易错操作，封装成明确 dry-run/confirm 命令能消除 ours/theirs 记忆负担，同时不隐藏真实代码冲突。

preMortem.trigger: 自动 checkout --ours 匹配路径过宽
preMortem.consequence: 真实业务冲突被误合并
preMortem.mitigation: 只自动处理 .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/ 前缀；其它 unmerged path 保留并报错

preMortem.scenario: 在 main 或错误 worktree 中执行
preMortem.trigger: 用户 cwd 不在 story worktree
preMortem.mitigation: 复用 assertCwdInWorktree 校验 storyId 与 cwd

preMortem.trigger: 为了探测冲突直接执行 git merge
preMortem.mitigation: dry-run 只输出当前分支、main 是否领先、命令计划，不执行 merge
